packMeta.name: RepairBench (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey electronics and device repair workshop desk: 7-stage repair pipeline board with printable claim tickets, device IMEI/serial intake registry, parts order tracker, interactive QA test checklist and pickup SMS desk, plus customers and bench technicians. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
